source_comments: LF-delimited UTF-8 JSON; max_line excludes LF and is capped at 1 MiB.
Replies preserve number lexemes, member order and duplicate members.
The peer must consume replies while uploading. Readiness waits are per operation;
sockets must be nonblocking; timeout is not a total request deadline.
JSON escaping can expand output; each response is bounded by 6 * max_line + 1 bytes.

source_comments: At most one reply and one 8192-byte received chunk are retained per peer.
Keep temporary receive/send byte arenas within one I/O operation.
LF-delimited UTF-8 JSON, preserving number lexemes, member order and duplicates.
max_line excludes LF; its fixed safety cap is 1 MiB. Replies <=6*max_line+1.
idle_ms is a batch-wide wait with no ready events, not a per-peer request deadline.
A stalled peer remains active until EOF/error or the batch's idle wait expires.
Caller owns listener; all accepted peers are closed here, including on failure.
peer_ms bounds time without actual received/sent bytes for each accepted peer.
total_ms bounds the whole batch, including continued traffic. Zero disables either.
Deadlines are checked between operations; this is not a real-time scheduling guarantee.
